title: Deer reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- deer body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- deer head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='14' ry='15' fill='#d99a5b'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='38' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#c48040' transform='rotate(-20 36 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='38' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#c48040' transform='rotate(20 64 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='39' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#f0b878' transform='rotate(-20 37 39)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='39' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#f0b878' transform='rotate(20 63 39)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M44 36 Q40 22 34 16 M41 28 Q36 25 33 22' stroke='#e8c070' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 36 Q60 22 66 16 M59 28 Q64 25 67 22' stroke='#e8c070' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='49' rx='2.8' ry='3.2' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='49' rx='2.8' ry='3.2' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='48' r='1' fill='#f0d0a0'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='48' r='1' fill='#f0d0a0'/>
  <!-- nose/muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#b07030'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#3a2010'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g>
    <rect x='32' y='64' width='16' height='20' rx='1.5' fill='#e05a5a'/>
    <rect x='48' y='64' width='16' height='20' rx='1.5' fill='#e05a5a'/>
    <rect x='32' y='64' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f08080'/>
    <rect x='48' y='64' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f08080'/>
    <line x1='48' y1='64' x2='48' y2='84' stroke='#a03030' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- page lines -->
    <line x1='35' y1='70' x2='45' y2='70' stroke='#ffe0d0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='35' y1='74' x2='45' y2='74' stroke='#ffe0d0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='35' y1='78' x2='43' y2='78' stroke='#ffe0d0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='51' y1='70' x2='61' y2='70' stroke='#ffe0d0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='51' y1='74' x2='61' y2='74' stroke='#ffe0d0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='51' y1='78' x2='59' y2='78' stroke='#ffe0d0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- hooves holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='80' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#8a5a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='80' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#8a5a2a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='40' y='84' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#b07840'/>
  <rect x='56' y='84' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#b07840'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#f0c890'/>
</svg>
